name: Dumbbell Single-Arm Reverse Fly
steps: Hinge at your hips beside the bench, supporting yourself with one hand and holding the dumbbell beneath the opposite shoulder.
Keep your spine neutral and maintain a slight bend in your working elbow with your palm facing inward.
Sweep the dumbbell out to the side until the working upper arm lines up with your torso.
Lower the dumbbell with control back to the start, and switch arms after finishing one side.
tips: Do not twist your torso open to swing the dumbbell higher.
Keep your shoulder away from your ear and lead the raise with the back of your shoulder and elbow.
